# AdyDaddy

> Marketing that's judged on revenue, not reach.

AdyDaddy is a performance marketing agency that plans, builds, and scales paid media, SEO, and content programs for D2C and growth-stage brands, scoping every engagement against payback, not vanity metrics.

## Services

- [Performance Marketing](https://adydaddy.com/services.html#performance-marketing): Paid media across Meta, Google, and YouTube, built around ROAS and payback period, not vanity clicks.
- [SEO + AEO / GEO](https://adydaddy.com/services.html#seo): Technical fixes, content, and authority building aimed at compounding organic traffic and answer-engine visibility.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://adydaddy.com/services.html#social): Organic content, community, and creator partnerships built to create demand, not just a posting calendar.
- [Content & Creative](https://adydaddy.com/services.html#creative): Ad creative, video, and design production built to perform in-feed, not just look good in a deck.
- [Marketing Automation & CRM](https://adydaddy.com/services.html#automation): Lifecycle email, SMS, and CRM flows designed to lift repeat revenue without adding ad spend.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://adydaddy.com/services.html#cro): Structured landing page and funnel experimentation that lifts conversion rate without more spend.
- [Website Development & Management](https://adydaddy.com/services.html#web): High-converting Shopify stores and marketing sites, built and maintained by people who understand the traffic that hits them.

## Results

- 1.8x average blended ROAS lift
- 4.1x average organic traffic growth
- ₹2Cr+ ad spend managed monthly
- 94% client retention
- $50M lifetime ad spend managed
- 20+ brands scaled
